goal: Generate a visual route map for a three-day classical itinerary in Kyoto, to be used as a cover image for social media guides and printed brochures.
style: Vintage hand-drawn and watercolor, beige parchment background with slight wax seal texture on the edges

title_section.title_text: Kyoto three days: gardens and ancient streets.
title_section.subtitle: D1–D3 Trails and Tracks That Do Not Retrace

stops: D1 Higashiyama District: Arrive at Kyoto Station → Kiyomizu-dera → Sannenzaka, Ninenzaka → Yasaka Shrine → Gion Shichinai at Dusk
D2 Arashiyama and the Western Suburbs: Small train at Saga Station → Bamboo Grove Path → Tenryu-ji Garden → Togetsu Bridge and riverside tea house → Handmade soba dinner
D3 Northern Mountains and Shimogamo: Kinkaku-ji mirror stroll → Kitano Tenmangu and plum blossom rice cakes → Shimogamo Path and Kawai Shrine → Kyoto Station tea-soaked rice conclusion
route.line_style: Crimson solid line indicates the main line of the day, indigo dashed line indicates the cross-zone maneuver segment, dotted numbers in the same color as the date

stop_illustrations: Each site is accompanied by small illustrations: three-tiered pagoda, stone lantern, bamboo path, moon bridge, reflection of the Golden Pavilion, handmade plum branch cake, and stream of ducks under the Qizhi Forest

side_panel.position: Vertical bar on the right side

D1: Morning clear water stage avoiding the crowd
Shirakawa-dori at dusk is suitable for photography.
D2: Little train and bamboo forest, recommend booking time slots
If the wind is strong on the Togetsu Bridge, can change to indoor tea house
Lanshan tofu and buckwheat as the main food line of the day
D3: The golden pavilion's mirror pool front is a must-photo point.
Visiting the Kawai Shrine water sign can be done next
You can buy tea stains and wagashi souvenirs at Kyoto Station.

items: Crimson solid line: Active line of the day
Green Octagon: Must-visit world heritage point
Little leaves: a townhouse or tea house where one can have tea and take a break

extras: Washi compass in the top left
Small text note: Hand-drawn illustration, not centimeter-level precise navigation

must_keep: D1→D3 Sequence self-consistent, orientation roughly reasonable
Each station has a picture and a name
Side bar does not compress the main image route
avoid: A day crammed with overly commercial attractions
Route label pressed over the illustration.
